cards.title: Request the Shamrock Re-entry
cards.leadIn: At 500 ft MSL, when directed by Tower, contact Corpus Departure (UHF CH 8):

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, Shamrock re-entry.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, radar contact <distance and direction> of Navy Corpus. Proceed course rules Shamrock re-entry.

cards.detail: Shamrock Re-entry is one of the course rules requests made on Corpus Departure. The exact phrases follow the Mustang check-in pattern and are not written out in the binder. Check with an instructor.
cards.source: Binder, p. 17; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slides 46, 62–65.
